name: Ngernturbo Public Company Limited
summary: Ngernturbo Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides financial services in Thailand. It operates through Financial Services and Insurance Broker segments. The company offers motorcycles, cars, tractors, and land title deed loans; and motorcycles, cars, health and critical illness, home and condo, and accident insurance products; and loans secured against vehicle registrations, land title deeds, and nano-finance. It also engages in cash and installment sales; insurance broker; training services; and life and non-life insurance brokerage and insurance consultation business. Ngernturbo Public Company Limited was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Pak Kret, Thailand.
